steps.code:
# Get all liked songs (paginate through all pages)
access_token = login_result['access_token']
liked_songs = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    liked_songs.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(f"Total liked songs: {len(liked_songs)}")
liked_ids = {song['song_id'] for song in liked_songs}
print(liked_ids)

steps.code:
# Keep going to the next song until we reach a liked song.
current_song = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
steps = 0
while current_song['song_id'] not in liked_ids:
    # Go to next song
    next_result = apis.spotify.next_song(access_token=access_token)
    print(f"Next song result: {next_result}")
    # Get the new current song
    current_song = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
    print(f"Now playing: {current_song['title']} (id={current_song['song_id']})")
    steps += 1
    # Safety break to avoid infinite loop (shouldn't happen)
    if steps > 100:
        print("Too many steps, aborting")
        break

print(f"Reached liked song after {steps} next steps. Song ID: {current_song['song_id']}, Title: {current_song['title']}")
